Hi all,

Reviewed Janet's initial asks. High level responses and proposed edits below — I’m attaching a marked-up "Redwood_Orderform_v3_KI_redline.docx" to the Drive.

1) Signing entity / billing liaison: we can add a clause that allows separate billing contacts (UK finance) while execution remains with LumenOps GmbH. This avoids re-execution between entities.

2) Rollback clause: acceptable with constraints. Proposed language: a 30-day rollback window triggered by (i) documented regulatory restriction OR (ii) mutual written agreement; rollback reduces provisioned capacity to the prior billable tier and issues a credit equal to unused capacity for remainder of current invoice cycle, calculated pro rata. We will not permit repeated rollbacks more than once per 12-month term.

3) Data retention / audit logs: we can commit to 12 months of access logs for audit purposes; however, long-term archival beyond that is subject to our retention policy and may require an add-on.

4) Indemnity / IP: Janet flagged a broader indemnity ask during the call. We propose preserving core Redwood indemnities and limiting consequential damages — suggest we push back on broad third-party indemnity language and instead include a mutual limitations section.

Operational notes: Ben — the rollback credit calculation will require us to lock in the pro rata unit price for the initial invoice. Monica — please confirm if ops can support a rollback reconfiguration inside a 48-hour SLA once triggered.

If LumenOps is okay with this direction, I can prepare a redline that implements these specific bullets and circulate by EOD.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
